name: notes
description: Sticky notes in Markdown on a project, a terminal or a file: coloured cards floating over their terminal or file preview, plus a NOTES section of the sidebar and a badge on every terminal and file that has one. Kept privately on the Perch server, never in the repository, so they're the same in every browser and on your phone.

notes.showChip.description: Show the Notes chip in the corner of each terminal and file preview (count, add, hide and show). With it off, the cards still float; use the NOTES section's eye button or the status-bar item to show, hide and add them.

notes.showStatusBar.description: Show a Notes item in the status bar: the count of notes on the active terminal, opening the same show/hide menu as the NOTES section's eye button.
